ball.q: Evian Thonon Gaillard reached Ligue 1 in 2011 bankrolled by the company that sells the water. Which company?
ball.a: Danone
ball.sub: The club folded in 2016 after the money stopped.

ball.q: Lens were told during 2014-15 that they would be relegated wherever they finished. Why?
ball.a: Their promotion was ruled invalid over a missing 10 million euro payment from shareholder Hafiz Mammadov

ball.q: When Dmitry Rybolovlev bought Monaco in December 2011, where were they in the table?
ball.a: Bottom of Ligue 2

ball.q: In 2015 Zlatan took his shirt off after scoring against Caen. What did it reveal?
ball.a: Tattoos of 50 names of people suffering from hunger, for a UN food charity
ball.sub: They were temporary tattoos.

ball.q: Zlatan said goodbye to PSG in 2016 with a famous line. Finish it: I came like a king...
ball.a: ...left like a legend

ball.q: After losing at Bordeaux in 2015, Zlatan was filmed raging about the referee and then insulting what?
ball.a: France itself, he called it a shit country
ball.sub: He apologised the next day.

ball.q: What did David Beckham do with his entire salary when he joined Paris Saint-Germain in 2013?
ball.a: He gave it all to a children's charity in Paris

ball.q: In 2017 Neymar and which PSG teammate had a public row over who should take a penalty against Lyon?
ball.a: Edinson Cavani
ball.sub: Cavani took it and missed.

ball.q: Bastia striker Brandão was banned for six months for headbutting which PSG midfielder in the tunnel in 2014?
ball.a: Thiago Motta
ball.sub: He broke Motta's nose.

ball.q: Radamel Falcao wrecked his knee in January 2014 and missed the World Cup. Who were Monaco playing?
ball.a: Monts d'Or Azergues, an amateur side, in the Coupe de France

ball.q: How did Mario Balotelli celebrate his goal for Marseille against Saint-Étienne in 2019?
ball.a: He filmed an Instagram story on a phone on the pitch

ball.q: Toulouse snatched a 2-2 draw against Rennes in 2012 with a header deep into stoppage time. Who scored it?
ball.a: Their goalkeeper, Ali Ahamada
ball.sub: He headed in a Wissam Ben Yedder free kick.

ball.q: Montpellier owner Louis Nicollin kept a promise after their 2012 title. What did he do?
ball.a: Had his hair cut into a mohawk, dyed orange and blue
ball.sub: He copied PSG winger Jérémy Ménez.

ball.q: In 2015 Zlatan took off his shirt against Caen to show 50 names inked on his body. Whose names were they?
ball.a: People suffering from hunger
ball.sub: Temporary tattoos for a World Food Programme campaign. He was booked.

ball.q: A Joey Barton press conference as a Marseille player in 2012 went viral. Why?
ball.a: He answered in English with a fake French accent

ball.q: PSG sporting director Leonardo got a long ban in 2013. What had he done after a game against Valenciennes?
ball.a: He shoved the referee
ball.sub: His nine-month ban was extended to 13 months, then overturned in court in 2014.

ball.q: Which English midfielder, on loan at Marseille in 2012, gave a press conference in a fake French accent?
ball.a: Joey Barton

ball.q: Zlatan Ibrahimović said in 2016 he would stay at Paris Saint-Germain if they replaced which landmark with a statue of him?
ball.a: The Eiffel Tower

ball.q: Which Paris Saint-Germain striker said on leaving in 2016 that he came like a king and left like a legend?
ball.a: Zlatan Ibrahimović

ball.q: Which Frenchman refused to play for West Ham in January 2017 until they sold him back to Marseille?
ball.a: Dimitri Payet
ball.sub: West Ham fans painted over his mural.

ball.q: What did David Beckham do with all of his Paris Saint-Germain wages in 2013?
ball.a: He gave them to a children's charity

ball.q: Weeks after his world record move in 2017, Neymar argued with which Paris Saint-Germain team-mate over a penalty?
ball.a: Edinson Cavani
